claim_ceiling: This establishes a reproducible public-raw-record reconstruction of the documented 18-period response surface, with an explicit 2011 date-missingness boundary. Sampling-effort semantics are resolved, but binary detection is materially effort-sensitive under repeated-census diagnostics, so the 853 binary changes cannot be identified as ecological rewiring events. sampling_effort_followup.consequence: The 853 changes are reproducible observed-link state changes, not 853 identified ecological rewiring events.
